How to play

      

        
        
BlockSlides anywhere, corners included.

        
GateSame color and symbol: push through to escape.

        
StoneNever moves.

        
MovesOne drag = one move. ★★★ at par · ★★ one over. Undo (↶) gives a move back; ? shows the next move.

        
        
Approval chainNumbered blocks leave in order. The solid stamp is next up; the outlined ones wait.

        
AROUND THE GAME

        
♥ LivesRetrying a failed level costs one (from level 6). They refill over time; a rescue saves the attempt instead.

        
Daily draftOne board a day, the same board for every player, with its own par. The first attempt is the one that is recorded; after that the day is practice. The field report you can share says how the day went, never how it was solved.

        
Field surveyOne sheet a week: a stamp for every day you clear a level, two contracts you pick from the four the week offers, and point marks at 3, 7, 12 and 20 (1 point per clear, +1 at par).

        
ContractsSwap freely until one of them earns a mark, then the pair is set for the week. File one and you bank a weather delay (hold up to 2); file both and the sheet gets its seal.

        
StreakOne clear a day keeps it going. A banked weather delay covers a missed day; otherwise it simply starts again.

        
Certification24 ★ on a sheet certifies it: a new paper for the drawing.
